privacy_boundary.retained: Field names, JSON types, presence, cardinality, counts, opaque sample IDs, source byte counts and SHA-256 identities, structural relationships, and non-sensitive operational categories.
privacy_boundary.prohibited: Human prompts, model or system responses, thinking text, tool arguments, tool results, command text, file contents, provider bodies, HTTP headers, environment values, credentials, personal communications, unpublished scientific content, and hashes of such payloads.
privacy_boundary.source_paths: Not retained; maintained source identities use SAMPLE-01 through SAMPLE-05.
privacy_boundary.opaque_payload_policy: Payload containers are inventoried by path and presence but their descendants and values are not retained unless a later explicit privacy contract permits specific metadata.

parser_implications: Parse line order and id/parentId separately; append order is not branch selection.
Dispatch on top-level type, then message.role, while preserving unknown kinds without inferred semantics.
Represent absent reasoning usage, tool-result usage, currency, task identity, retry identity, and lifecycle completion as unavailable rather than zero.
Redact or reject payload-bearing fields before any provisional observation is retained.
Keep version-3 observed structure provisional; do not freeze the normalized event contract from these five samples.
Treat wall-clock intervals as retrospective proxies and defer monotonic provider, streaming, tool, concurrency, and wait measurements to live instrumentation.
